data.name: MapleStory
data.detailed_description:
Join over 260 Million Global Players in MapleStory, one of the original MMORPGs, where epic adventure, action-packed gameplay, & good friends await you! Featuring an iconic 2D art style, MapleStory offers the thrill of explosive power, bold anime-style self-expression, and absolute control of your characters’ awesome abilities. Build your perfect custom hero from over 40 distinct classes with thousands of unique cosmetic options, and set off on your journey to face never-ending challenges and enjoy extraordinary rewards. Discover Your Story!

Key Features:



Create a gaming experience as unique as your personality by designing your own MapleStory hero. With over 40 unique classes to choose from, each with their own amazing abilities as well as an almost limitless number of cosmetic options, your hero will truly become one-of-a-kind.  Become a leader in the Maple Alliance and a legendary hero to inspire players for years to come.



Welcome to MapleStory, the original side-scrolling MMORPG where epic adventure, action and good friends await you. With hundreds of hours of gameplay, this immersive role-playing experience will allow you to conquer perilous dungeons, overcome terrifying bosses, socialize with your friends and much more.



Immerse yourself in Maple World’s rich lore-filled history and epic storylines as you traverse lush forests, arid deserts, frozen tundras, underwater kingdoms, lost civilizations, and even a city in the sky! With hundreds of locations to roam, secrets to discover, and bosses to master, MapleStory offers a wealth of gameplay for you to uncover.

reviews.review:
Stay far, far, far away from this game. Both Global MapleStory and Classic MapleStory. This game has by far been one of the most predatory games in existence. This is coming from someone who has played it since 2006. I've seen it ALL. Let me first start with their newest "Classic" scam.

Their team has been dangling the Classic carrot over players' heads promising no Pay to Win for 2 years only to have the game launch with tradeable microtransactions that were immediate on launch and kept undisclosed until launch. They make the actual game a slog where you can barely even afford potions unless you fork up real world $$$. Then the economy gets ruined by botters, macroers, and an exploit (Bandit exploit). They had 2 Closed Online Tests and didn't even manage to catch the bug. They should have had more testing and more people testing it, but instead turned their predatory "Founder's Access" scam basically into a 3rd beta test.

The game is overpopulated. There aren't enough servers to accommodate the player base EVEN THOUGH they had data on how many players would be playing by having a Founder's Access where people pre-purchased. It was so bad day 1 I gave up on even trying to play it. The game would just constantly crash. I spent 3 hours just trying to create 3 characters. I gave up at 2. I'd get a really good in-game username and hit "Create Character" to have the game crash before it was created. I'd then spend 45 minutes trying to get back online to recreate it and by the time the game decided to work my names were gone. And when trying to login at the initial launch my game would crash with at least 6 different error codes and probably more (maybe 1 or 2 were actually accurate errors). I used a Mac and a Windows PC when trying to log on because I didn't know which would be more stable. I gave up on the Mac when I got a "you're region is unsupported" error even though both computers were sitting in the same room.

Next is a HUGE oversight with their in-game currency. I spent $10 for their currency on my account for a couple of convenience items. I login on Classic and it's not there. Non-existent. It turns out the developers screwed up and the account you linked through Steam is bugged and doesn't actually use your current account. Instead it uses the ORIGINAL EMAIL that created the account even if that email is long gone since 2008. Even if that email is not even used to login to your Nexon account, that's the email they chose to use. So basically my $10 was wasted and sitting in my Nexon account and can't be used except on GMS. I tried submitting a ticket through my browser to report the bug so I can actually use the money I spent and the submit button doesn't even work. Urgency is of priority to get my $10 to work in the game because everyone is racing to get footing in the game and the convenience I payed for turned into 10x the inconvenience.

MapleStory Classic is one of the biggest disappointments in gaming history.

Their Founder's Access is such a scam it's not even funny. Many people were getting refunds because they payed for promises that were broken. And the price point is ASTRONOMICAL for how horrible the gamestate's condition is in. Also they gave "Founders" WAY too much of a headstart versus their actual "Free" global launch of Classic. 2 weeks. A 2 week head start in a game like this is an eternity. The devs promised no FOMO but then pull their Founders Access scam. The game is a mess. It's a race to the bottom. There is such little communication. The events are so poorly communicated that they're wasting peoples time. Like they announce there's an event, but they don't tell you what channel it's on. People are just sitting their and asking everyone if they know what to do. Or if you managed to miraculously be in the right channel, you may be *** out of luck because the event is full. You're never told there's limited space. You didn't know you were supposed to be clicking rapidly to get in before others because there is NO COMMUNICATION.

I tried doing the Coconut event and I missed even though I clicked 3 seconds after the GM announced they're ready for the next round. So I missed and had to wait another 20 minutes or so. Also we didn't know if we had to be in a party because it was a team event. Nobody told us anything. When I did get in they explain the event, but it's AFTER THE TIME ALREADY STARTED. So we're supposed to read all the lengthy rules while the other team gets ahead because they already know how to play? On top of it I am pretty certain the event was BUGGED. People were attacking the same coconut for 15-20 minutes and the coconuts never fell.

Then there's the race to level cap. Some people like to compete, but it's a losing game in MapleStory. If you're not a whale, not a botter, or an exploiter you can kiss your competition goodbye. If you're not dropping hundreds to thousands of dollars on the game or literally hacking it you will not be in the top ranks. Great game guys. Really great game.

Nexon is a billion dollar corporation. They have the funds to fund it. And I get that's not always how things work with new projects or w/e. But SO many people payed them $60-$80 for Founders Access which goes directly to the project. WAY more people bought it than I ever expected. Use that money to add another channel for C*****'s sake. Add some channels, get a PR team who can actually communicate, and hire some security engineers. I just don't understand where the money goes. Allegedly Classic has already had 13,000 concurrent online players. Let's say they just payed the minimum price of $60 (though a lot bought the $80 package). 13k x 60 is $780,000 dollars already. And that's using the lowest possible denomination. Where does it all go?

This is not Nexon/Wizet's first rodeo. They've been running live services since before 2006. They've had 20 years to perfect being a live service provider. Instead it's just been 20 years of scamming and milking people for every cent they can. In this current post I'm writing I've only gone over CLASSIC MapleStory which has only been out for A WEEK. Imagine how much more I have to say about GMS (Global MapleStory), the game they're slowly pivoting from because they know it's a sinking ship. Read the other Steam reviews. It's. Not. Good. They got caught given false probability rates and scammed over $400 MILLION from players. When they got caught all they had to do was pay a fine of ~$9mil. A DROP IN THE BUCKET of the millions they made scamming their loyal fanbase. Then there was the time they advertised an 'Ability' you could obtain by rolling the dice with your $. YOU COULDN'T EVEN GET THE ABILITY. It didn't even EXIST. So people spent thousands of dollars for an absolute 0% chance of getting the product they were paying for.

Disgusting. Predatory. There's some sort of stockholm syndrome they've developed with their players. They know underneath all of the lies, the gambling, and the exploitation of players they have the potential for a good game. The music's good. The graphics are amazing. The gameplay loop can be fun. It can be social. So they use all of this to con people into starting the game in the first place. I feel most people stay because of a sunk fallacy cost to be truly honest.

Stay away. Stay far, far away. Pull a grinch on this one and don't touch it with a 39 1/2' pole. I hate myself that I fell into the trap. But I was 12 when I got pulled in by the colorful cutesy graphics then got groomed into buying NX. That's real talk. It's a children's casino. There's a reason Dutch countries implemented a restriction on Nexon when trading because by law it's gambling. I hope this review saves someone's life.

lol
